scores.evidence: Phase 1 "Defenses and budgets" → Phase 2 retrieval/model/triage → Phase 3 sandbox → Phase 4 PRs; "Depends on" listed per phase with V-gates.
scores.rationale: Phases run substrate → defenses → capabilities, with explicit dependency map and validation gates before dependent work.

scores.evidence: A real issue is opened in a dedicated test repo... The agent posts a comment proposing labels... Through CI/CD with infrastructure as code, from the first commit.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real, deployed, end-to-end thin slice across all tiers with rollback and exit check.

scores.evidence: Data-privacy boundary... Default: Hosted API under zero-retention... Flip condition: V1 fails, or policy forbids external code egress.
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions have reversibility class, default, assumption, validation, and flip condition; R1 defaults listed too.

scores.evidence: Tasks, widest blast radius first: 1. Tool executor as a policy layer...
scores.rationale: Explicit blast-radius ordering within phases (executor policy first; smallest exposure first in Phase 2 shadow→suggest→auto).

scores.evidence: Phase 0: HMAC-verified webhook. Least-privilege App. Secrets in a secret manager. Allow-listed repo and authors.
scores.rationale: Concrete security controls in every phase 0–5 in the cross-cutting table and phase tasks.

scores.evidence: One OpenTelemetry trace keyed by the webhook delivery ID spans every tier... Alerts cover worker errors, model API failures
scores.rationale: Observability built in Phase 0 and extended concretely in each later phase.

scores.evidence: IaC. Digest-pinned images. Prompts in version control.
scores.rationale: Reproducibility treated per phase: pinned models, index SHA, sandbox image, versioned eval sets and configs.

scores.evidence: Idempotent on delivery ID. Kill switch. Tested rollback.
scores.rationale: Resilience appears concretely in every phase (caps, reconciliation poll, teardown, cleanup scripts, per-repo kill).

scores.evidence: Skeleton basics in Phase 0, full in Phase 1 ... Retrieval Phase 2 ... Memory Phase 2 ... Orchestration Phase 3 ... Routing Phase 5 ... Feedback Phase 5
scores.rationale: Defenses, budgets, and HITL precede retrieval → model access → memory → orchestration → routing → feedback in correct order.

scores.evidence: Autonomous merge or auto-close of issues: pulled forward only by a new gate with a named approver, after sustained V5-level acceptance
scores.rationale: Explicit deferred list with concrete pull-forward conditions for each item.

note: Exceptionally thorough plan meeting all rubric dimensions with concrete content; only minor quibbles (e.g., Phase 1 defenses after a Phase 0 skeleton that already calls a model, mitigated by basics and allow-listing).
